arStrings.szText: The longer {c_important}Profane Sentinel{/c} is locked onto the same enemy the stronger it becomes, dealing {c_number}[{SF_16}*100|%|]{/c} more damage every second.

You can now summon multiple {c_important}Profane Sentinels{/c} but can no longer redirect their gaze. {c_important}Profane Sentinels{/c} deal {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_MULTI}{/c} damage and fire extra blasts at any Nearby {c_important}{u}Stealthed{/u}{/c} enemies.
{c_important}Profane Sentinel{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_26}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage when it only hits a single target.
Casting {c_important}Profane Sentinel{/c} induces your {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} Skills to make enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_27}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Profane Sentinel{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_29}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage but its blast area is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_30}*100|%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Profane Sentinel{/c} becomes a {c_important}Hellfire{/c} eye blast attack that transforms you into {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c}, dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_DF}{/c} damage and {c_important}{u}Weakening{/u}{/c} enemies.
